
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/52youths/p/19147080" title="发布于 2025-10-17 09:41">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">flutter openharmony项目新手从0到1的保姆级教程</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div data-version="3.0.0" data-hash="928ec33f1f34f92bb8ecc87de4ba506f">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="document">
<div class="section">
<h1 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 1"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">flutter <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">oh项目新手从0到1的保姆级教程</span></span></h1>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">前言</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">很多的坑踩过才知道，保姆级教程就是无脑跟随作者的教程走，不要有自己的想法<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。请注意，如果你读到这个文章，请必须严格按照文档顺序操作，保证一把过，如果有个人思想跳过部分章节，请自己排坑。</span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">请准备好鸿蒙5的设备<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，必须要鸿蒙5及以上系统，<strong>其低于这个版本的系统就别看本文章了</strong></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">一、配置<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">开发环境</span></span></h2>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1、下载DevEco Studio编辑器</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">默认安装，不要有自己的想法，默认就行</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2、配置ohpm 和 hvigorw 环境变量</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">将ohpm、hvigorw添加到系统 PATH</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">C:\Program Files\Huawei\DevEco Studio\tools\ohpm\bin

C:\Program Files\Huawei\DevEco Studio\tools\hvigor\bin</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">测试命令：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>全局cmd操作：ohpm -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">v

项目里面操作：hvigorw </span>-v</pre>
</div>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">3<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">配置HOS_SDK_HOME环境变量</span></span></span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="ui-monospace">在用户、系统环境变量里面，新增一个<span data-font-family="ui-monospace">HOS_SDK_HOM<span data-font-family="ui-monospace">E<span data-font-family="ui-monospace">变量，地址为<span data-font-family="ui-monospace">你编辑器里面的地址，并且创建2个文件夹，分别为：<span data-font-family="Microsoft YaHei">openharmony<span data-font-family="Microsoft YaHei">、<span data-font-family="Microsoft YaHei">hmscore</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span class="image-wrapper"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2407038/202510/2407038-20251017094049979-971068489.png" width="531.7333333333333" height="252.32965879265092" id="6e490178"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span class="image-wrapper"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2407038/202510/2407038-20251017094049934-357781322.png" width="531.733" height="339.44" id="0d3fdcf5"></span></p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">4<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">配置<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">DEVECO_SDK_HOME环境变量</span></span></span></span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">在“系统变量”中点击“新建”，添加以下内容：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">变量名：DEVECO_SDK_HOME

变量值：DevEco SDK的安装路径（例如：C:\Huawei\DevEcoStudio\SDK）</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify">&nbsp;</p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">5、配置HDC环境变量</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">安装好DevEco Studio之后<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，能在setting中看到下载的路径，可能会自动配置hdc变量，配置你下载的api的地址，但是可以自己配置或检查，将hdc配置到系统path中，请到自己的目录中查看，我的路径为</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>C:\Users\yang\AppData\Local\OpenHarmony\Sdk\<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span>\toolchains</pre>
</div>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span class="image-wrapper"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2407038/202510/2407038-20251017094049979-971068489.png" width="554.133" height="262.959" id="7b02a64d"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">6、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">配置node环境变量</span></span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">用到了node，在DevEco中有提供安装，直接在系统变量的path中添加</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>C:\Program Files\Huawei\DevEco Studio\tools\node</pre>
</div>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">7、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">下载oh的flutter</span></span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">本次开发使用的3.27.4版本，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">用git clone下载，不要下载zip，不要有自己的想法，请遵循保姆级教程逻辑</span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>git clone -b oh-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3.27</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>-dev https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">gitcode.com/openharmony-tpc/flutter_flutter.git</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify">&nbsp;</p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">8、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">下载android studio</span></span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">官网下载，这一步是拿来写代码用的编辑器，如果不想使用可以用其他编辑器</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">二、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">初始化环境</span></span></h2>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4">1、&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">初始化flutter</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">在下载好的oh flutter中，打开命令行，运行命令</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>flutter doctor</pre>
</div>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">这一步会自动下载初始化该版本的dart</span></p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4">2、&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">打开DevEco Studio</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">这一步可能会自动下载部分环境初始化</span></p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4">3、&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">打开Android studio</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">这一步可能会自动下载部分环境初始化</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 2">三、&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">设备连接</span></h2>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4">1、&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">设备准备</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">请准备好鸿蒙5的设备<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，必须要鸿蒙5及以上系统，其低于这个版本的系统就别装了</span></span></span></span></p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4">2、&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">启用开发者选项和 USB 调试</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">开发者选项开启请在关于本机中，软件版本连续点击5次开启</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">确保已开启：</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">设置 → 系统和更新 → 开发人员选项</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">开启 "USB调试"</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">开启 "仅充电模式下允许调试"（如果有）</span></p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">3、设备连接</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">HDC（HarmonyOS Device Connector）是鸿蒙的设备连接工具，类似于 Android 的 ADB。命令行中输入hdc list targets 如果设备已连接，会显示设备的序列号。如果没有连接，则不会显示任何设备。</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">四、项目初始化</span></h2>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4">3、&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">在Android studio中创建或打开flutter项目</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">创建好项目之后输入</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>flutter pub <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span> </pre>
</div>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑"><span data-font-family="ui-monospace"><span data-font-family="ui-monospace">下载基础依赖</span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify">&nbsp;</p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4">4、&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">初始化oh环境</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">在项目的控制台中输入&nbsp;</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>flutter create --platforms=ohos .</pre>
</div>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="Microsoft YaHei">为现有项目添加 HarmonyOS 平台</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify">&nbsp;</p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4">5、&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">验证项目</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">控制台输入</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>flutter devices</pre>
</div>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">查看项目支持的平台</span></p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4">6、&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">引入依赖</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">特殊的oh包需要单独的引入，注意：如果包为全平台通用包，不需要单独引入包来源，即包中没有Android、iOS等平台文件夹，如果存在就要单独创建，开鸿这边给出的方式为</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  flutter_zxing:
    git:
      url: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://gitcode.com/openharmony-sig/fluttertpc_flutter_zxing.git</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  device_info_plus:       # 设备型号、系统版本
    git:
      url: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://gitcode.com/openharmony-sig/flutter_plus_plugins.git</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      path: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">packages/device_info_plus/device_info_plus</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
<pre></pre>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4">7、&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">启动项目</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">输入命令，这2个命令都会启动，第一个命令会自动寻找oh设备</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>flutter run</pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>flutter run -d ohos </pre>
</div>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑"><span data-font-family="ui-monospace"><span data-font-family="ui-monospace">启动过程如果有多个设备会让选择使用哪个设备进行启动，或者Android studio直接点击运行，会自动识别并编译启动oh环境</span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 2">四、&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">底层开发</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="ui-monospace">如果你的包没有支持oh，但是你又想使用支持</span></p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4">1、&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">下载包</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="ui-monospace">github中下载你的包，并且打开项目</span></p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4">2、&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">创建oh平台</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="ui-monospace">在项目中创建oh平台</span></p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4">3、&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">oh支持</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="ui-monospace">在原有的逻辑中，编码oh平台逻辑</span></p>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4">4、&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">引入包</span></h4>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="ui-monospace">在项目初始化段落中，依赖引入章节方式引入</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">五<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">异常问题</span></span></span></h2>
<h4 class="paragraph text-align-type-justify tco-title-heading 4"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">提示路径映射问题</span></span></span></h4>
<blockquote>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="sans-serif">Make sure the srcPath in the hvigorconfig.ts file of the project is a relative path.</span></p>
</blockquote>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">请查看这个issues:</span></p>
<blockquote><a href="https://gitcode.com/openharmony-tpc/flutter_packages/issues/621" rel="noopener nofollow"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">https://gitcode.com/openharmony-tpc/flutter_packages/issues/621</span></a></blockquote>
</div>
</div>
</div>
